_comment: FR-3 rejected-alternatives rendering. Two decisions carry an Alternatives line exactly as buildNoteMemoryText projects one (own line, after content and Subject). Locks both halves of the AC: the 'already rejected:' line is present at a generous budget, and — the half that needs a mechanism — under a binding budget the decision survives while its alternatives line does not. The second fixture fails against any implementation that glues the alternatives onto the decision's own line: either the line carries them (excludes violated) or the decision is dropped to afford them (contains missed). Timestamps are excluded from every needle because the scenario clock is generation-time. The two fixtures use different topics deliberately — findFixtureRegressions keys its baseline map on fixture.topic, so two fixtures sharing one topic would silently collapse into a single entry.

items.subject: auth strategy
items.text:
Decision: use OIDC with server-side sessions in src/auth/oidc.ts.
Subject: auth strategy
Alternatives: session cookies (no SSO path), JWT-in-localStorage (XSS surface)

items.subject: auth session store
items.text:
Decision: keep the auth session store in redis in src/auth/session-store.ts.
Subject: auth session store
Alternatives: in-process memory (breaks on every restart), sticky sessions at the load balancer

items.subject: auth token refresh
items.text: Insight: auth token refresh happens server-side only, so the browser never holds a refresh token at all.
